name: Studio
purpose: A design studio that lives in your repo: studies, engineering notes, and working UI experiments kept beside the code they describe, open to the agents that help you build it.
rules: Run bun test before claiming done; cloud host changes are proven against a live VM with headless renders.
Never alias bare react imports to a directory; React is a platform singleton.
Never force-push a studio repo or ship node_modules or build output.
Credentials come from the keychain via secret; never read dotenv files, pass secrets as argv, or print them.
Gitmoji commit prefixes; no co-author footers or Generated-with lines.
